title: 23-BCV-008 — Residential exhaust outlet clearance from air intakes (REV1 and superseded 2024 issue)

facts.text: The variance applies to moisture-bearing kitchen, bathroom and clothes-dryer exhaust serving an individual dwelling unit or a house with a secondary suite.
REV1 uses Figure A: minimum 900 mm clearance horizontally and above the air intake, and 1 800 mm below it; page 2 states more stringent manufacturer instructions apply.
facts.locator: REV1 PDF pp.1–3, Discussion/Figure A; page 3 rendered and visually inspected

facts.text: The June 2024 issue broadly allowed 900 mm from air intakes; the official catalogue and its PDF mark that issue superseded, and list 23-BCV-008(REV1) as the replacement.
facts.locator: June PDF pp.1–3; catalogue row/API metadata

facts.text: Both records have API resource state active; only the June title is prefixed [SUPERSEDED].
facts.locator: Official catalogue API resource metadata, retrieved 2026-10-24 America/Edmonton
